s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and neurological symptoms with multi-organ involvement and a possible malignant process
salient_findings: Multiple pulmonary nodules and pleural effusion
Left adrenal mass and pelvic mass
key_facts: Diffuse crackles in the upper and lower lung fields
Markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase of 2764 U/L
Oxygen saturation of 83% to 87% on 6 L nasal cannula
Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve
Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on core-needle biopsy of pelvic mass

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and neurological symptoms with multi-organ involvement and a possible malignant process
salient_findings: Multiple pulmonary nodules and pleural effusion
Left adrenal mass and pelvic mass
key_facts: Diffuse crackles in the upper and lower lung fields
Markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase of 2764 U/L
Oxygen saturation of 83% to 87% on 6 L nasal cannula
Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve
Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on core-needle biopsy of pelvic mass

differentials: Germ cell tumor with somatic differentiation
Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor
Intimal sarcoma of the pulmonary artery
per_call: Germ cell tumor with somatic differentiation
Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor
Intimal sarcoma of the pulmonary artery

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and multi-organ involvement

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma of the heart
shortlist.why_kept: Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve and malignant cells on biopsy

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and involvement of multiple organs

shortlist.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and acute onset of symptoms

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma with pulmonary involvement
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells and multi-organ involvement including pulmonary nodules

raw.rationale: The presence of malignant cells lining vascular spaces on biopsy, along with symptoms such as worsening fatigue, dyspnea, hemoptysis, and markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase, are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, a rare and aggressive form of lymphoma that often presents with systemic symptoms and multi-organ involvement.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma of the heart
rejected.why: While the cardiac mass is consistent with angiosarcoma, the biopsy findings of malignant cells lining vascular spaces and the presence of systemic symptoms are more suggestive of intravascular lymphoma.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: This is a rare vascular tumor that can present with similar symptoms, but the biopsy findings and the presence of a right atrial mass with prolapse across the tricuspid valve are more consistent with intravascular lymphoma.

rejected.label: Intravascular lymphoma
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, but the specific diagnosis of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is more precise and consistent with the biopsy findings and clinical presentation.

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma with pulmonary involvement
rejected.why: While Kaposi's sarcoma can present with pulmonary involvement and systemic symptoms, the biopsy findings of malignant cells lining vascular spaces and the presence of a right atrial mass are not typical of Kaposi's sarcoma.
